stories.title: Greater Victoria bus drivers plan one-day full-scale strike for next Friday
stories.summary: The system-wide strike comes after B.C. Transit refused binding arbitration, Unifor Local 333 said in a statement.

stories.title: Architect selected to design new downtown Art Gallery of Greater Victoria
stories.summary: CEO Nancy Noble said the selection of Vancouver-based Michael Green Architects brings the gallery one step closer to building the long-awaited new facility.

stories.title: Harry Kane undergoes surgery overnight on ankle injury that will keep him out for months
stories.summary: MUNICH (AP) — England captain Harry Kane is looking to come back improved for “the business end of the season” after undergoing surgery on a ligament tear that will keep the Bayern Munich star out for several months.

stories.title: Tower developer gets $4.6M tax break in return for below-market units
stories.summary: Ten per cent of the units in the 266-unit View Street rental building would be rented at about 30 per cent below the market rate.

stories.title: Transitional housing provides more than a safe home for youth
stories.summary: The YMCA-YWCA provides transitional housing for young people in Victoria, thanks to funding from the Times Colonist Christmas Fund.

stories.title: Ottawa says it lost $2M from emergency drug stockpile after freezer malfunction
stories.summary: OTTAWA — The Public Health Agency of Canada has reported losing another $2 million in pharmaceuticals from the national emergency stockpile because of the mechanical failure of a freezer.
